deals.title: Cruising the Crossroads
deals.summary: $2.75 wells and $4 domestics; Station 4 stop 10-10:30pm, no cover
deals.evidence:
Cruising the Crossroads
We're back baby! $2.75 wells and $4.00 domestics every Friday and Saturday. Cheat Code Lounge 8:00-8:30pm, Sue Ellen's (no cover) 8:30-9:00pm, JR's Bar & Grill 9:00-9:30pm, TMC 9:30-10:00pm, Station 4 (no cover) 10:00-10:30pm.

notes: The site never names 'The Big Top'. 3911 Cedar Springs Rd is listed as Station 4 (S4), so it was treated as that location. Cruising the Crossroads is a rotating bar crawl, and Station 4's slot is 10:00-10:30pm. It is suspended during special events, and prices are subject to change. Other drink specials (Monday Industry Night, Trashy Tuesday) are at TMC, 3903 Cedar Springs, and Trashy Tuesday's details are in an ad image anyway. One-off events were skipped.
